title: Versioned path-scoped business approval policy
description: PROPOSED canonical Git policy. CODEOWNERS remains engineering-only. One independent approver is required in MVP; quorum and multiple approvers are deferred. Exactly one longest normalized path-prefix rule selects the eligible groups; less-specific rules never widen that selection.

x-contract-invariants.rule: rule_id is unique within rules. Duplicate rule_id makes the complete bundle invalid and preserves the previously active bundle.

Normalize each path_prefix to NFC with forward slashes before activation. A prefix is '/' or starts with exactly one '/', has no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no trailing slash, no backslash/control character, and no ambiguous separator. The canonical value must equal the stored value after NFC normalization.
Normalized path_prefix values are unique. Identical prefixes are rejected even when rule_id or external_group_ids differ; '/pricing' and '/pricing/' and NFC/NFD duplicates cannot coexist.

For a normalized absolute document path, consider only rules whose prefix is '/' or equals the complete path or ends at a path-segment boundary of that path. Select exactly one rule with the greatest normalized prefix length. Only external_group_ids of that selected rule are eligible; groups from less-specific rules are not unioned. If no rule matches, review is denied.

path_prefix.description: NFC-normalized path prefix for review routing only; it does not create a page-level read ACL.
